name: Devang Ray
tagline: Software engineer with experience building cloud-native applications, CI/CD pipelines, and secure authentication systems across enterprise and startup environments.

bullets: I led development of a cloud-native web application and CI/CD pipeline while overhauling authentication for a 10,000+ user enterprise portal, reducing support tickets, improving deployment reliability, and driving AI-adoption initiatives across a 50-developer tribe.

I led the release of a customer portal serving 1200+ active users, built over a dozen microservices to expand marketplace functionality, and migrated enterprise credentials to AWS Secrets Manager with zero service disruption.
I modernized a legacy knowledge portal into a responsive web application and implemented a keyword search feature, significantly reducing customer support requests and average search times.
I built data analysis and visualization tools to monitor the company's central messaging flow, proactively identifying system errors and reducing propagated failures.
I refactored a quarter of backend API endpoints to enforce input validation and parameterized queries, reducing SQL injection exposure across confidential data for 20,000 schools.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Summa Cum Laude (GPA: 3.91)
education.institution: University of Virginia School of Engineering & Applied Science
